purpose: Homepage section concept mockups for review

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity raster mockup of ONE NEW HOMEPAGE SECTION for the Arabic Iraqi restaurant website Super Sauce. This is a proposed design, not a claim about an actual restaurant feature. Use a landscape composition approximately 1536x1024, very sharp UI typography and appetizing photorealistic food. Show the section straight-on as a flat website screenshot, no laptop, device frame, browser chrome, mockup perspective, navigation or footer. The section fills nearly the entire canvas, with a discreet plain bottom margin caption saying "SUPER SAUCE — SECTION CONCEPT" in small sans serif type to mark this as a proposal. Existing brand: campaign red #ce1725, deep red #a6101c, warm cream #faf7ef, butter yellow #ffe044, near-black ink #26221f. Arabic is right-to-left; use bold geometric Arabic typography closely matching Alexandria, accurately joined letters. Editorial restaurant campaign quality, generous whitespace, simple purposeful layout, lightly rounded rectangular buttons, tiny five-point star motifs only where specified. Preserve restaurant feel, avoid generic SaaS dashboards. Use only the exact Arabic text provided, no invented testimonials, claims, ratings, discounts or offers. No cart, basket, heart/favorite button, checkout, quantity stepper or delivery promise. Do not invent or recreate a logo. This is new illustrative content, not an edit of an earlier screenshot.
Concept: an interactive taste quiz helping visitors choose an existing meal; an entirely new homepage section.
Composition: warm cream background. Right half is the functional quiz in RTL alignment, with large dark headline exactly "محتار؟ خلّها علينا." under it the short supporting text "جاوب على ذوقك، ونقترح لك وجبة." A fine red horizontal progress line with one of three positions active, not numbered decorative step cards. Below, a medium-size question exactly "شنو الطعم اللي تحبه؟" and three wide inline choice buttons: "سموكي" selected in red with white text; "جبني" and "حار" unselected in cream with a fine warm border. A strong red rectangular button underneath says "شوف اقتراحي" with a small left arrow. A subtle text option says "أو تصفح المنيو".
Left half is one large cutout photorealistic beef cheeseburger with sesame bun, char-grilled patty, melted cheddar and smoky sauce, grounded naturally with soft photographic shadow on the same cream backdrop. The food image occupies most of this half, not a grid of cards. Under the burger, aligned right, a compact red selected-meal title "سموكي برغر" with price exactly "6,500 د.ع" and one small red text link "شوف الوجبة". A single small red five-point star near the upper left adds a brand accent. Keep interface clearly legible with body labels at comfortable reading size. Rich natural food texture and natural restaurant food photography, professional finished website design.

Concept: a cinematic interactive exploded burger ingredient section, teaching what is inside the meal.
Composition: bold flat campaign-red full-width background. At top-right, a large two-line cream Arabic headline exactly "كل طبقة، إلها سالفة." with short cream supporting copy beneath "اكتشف مكونات سموكي برغر." Plenty of breathing room. The central and slightly left visual is a spectacular ultra-realistic exploded cheeseburger, five clearly separated horizontally stacked ingredients vertically suspended in natural alignment: golden sesame top bun, glossy rich smoky sauce with melted cheddar, thick char-grilled beef patty, crisp lettuce and tomato, bottom bun. Each ingredient has authentic appetizing texture, directional studio lighting, deep detail; not a toy or 3D illustration. The ingredients take about 65% of the canvas height and form a deliberate vertical composition. Four fine cream horizontal callout leader lines with small yellow circular hotspot endpoints connect specific layers to exactly these Arabic labels, distributed neatly on both sides without crossing: "خبز البرغر", "صوص سموكي", "جبن شيدر", "لحم مشوي". Medium-size cream labels, all readable, keep leaders clear of the hero headline. One butter-yellow rectangular button at bottom-right labeled exactly "شوف تفاصيل الوجبة" with a dark left arrow. Tiny instructional text near bottom says "اضغط على المكونات واكتشف التفاصيل". A very small yellow five-point star accent in the upper-left corner, no stickers, no busy decoration. Thin red-and-cream checkerboard strip along the section bottom, restrained. This should feel like a compelling interactive food editorial section designed to live midway down an existing restaurant homepage.

Concept: an editorial behind-the-scenes kitchen video section that adds real food-making story and motion to the homepage. It must look materially different from a product grid and the other concepts.
Composition: warm cream background, clear asymmetric magazine layout. Across the top right is a large ink Arabic heading exactly "قبل أول لقمة." The line immediately below says "من الشواية للصوص، شوف السالفة." Top-left a compact red text link says "شوف التحضير" with a small outward arrow.
Under the headline spans a very wide cinematic feature-video still, about two-thirds of the entire canvas height. It shows a close-up of a cook's black-gloved hands carefully pouring glossy orange smoky sauce onto a freshly assembled cheeseburger on a red tray. Only hands and food, no faces. Background shows a softly defocused stainless restaurant kitchen and warm grill lighting. The burger is large and incredibly appetizing, sesame bun, char-grilled beef, melted cheese, sauce drizzle captured midair. Authentic photographic food texture, shallow depth of field, warm highlights, deep charcoal background. Place a single butter-yellow circular play button with a dark clean triangular play glyph on the image, slightly left of center where it doesn't cover the burger. It visibly reads as a playable video.
Along the bottom of the feature image are three restrained, equally spaced small chapter labels in white over a dark legible lower band: from right to left exactly "على الشواية", "لمسة الصوص", "جاهزة للّقمة". Each label has one tiny horizontal progress segment underneath, first red active and others cream; no times, no invented view counts. A narrow red-and-cream checkerboard seam at the very bottom. Spacious layout, crisp type, almost all detail comes from the gorgeous kitchen photograph, no nested cards and no extra marketing claims.
